description: This course guides students through crafts of poetry writing through the lens of Asian Diasporic creative and community practices. From public poems at Angel Island to intimate, multilingual acts of memory, crafts of Asian Diasporic poetry reimagine English-language prosodies to speak to lived experiences of coloniality, forced migration, and racial-gendered violence. In a workshop setting, students explore techniques, develop poems of their own, and learn how to refine drafts through peer critique and reflection. Prerequisite: WRIT 120 or equivalent.
